# Two Forms & Fields captions read whole within two lines

## Context

Finding 4 of Friday's gate read on #21140 ([comment](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/21140#issuecomment-7041152372)), named by both cold readers: captions are cut mid-claim. #21584 (PR #21585) lets a compact card's caption take two lines instead of one, and leaves "the six captions longer than two lines" to each group's lane, since `examples.json` edits collide (#21539). Two of the six are Forms & Fields records, this lane's (#21329). Owned by that lane and due before the Sun 22 Nov 17:00Z examples lock, so it carries no contributor labels.

## The Problem

Measured on PR #21585's head `0a52d935da` (local Portal, dev mode, dark theme). For every card view of the two records, a caption counts as cut when `.portal-example-feature` has `scrollHeight > clientHeight + 1` at rest:

| Record (characters) | Cut at two lines | Reads whole |
|---|---|---|
| Multi-Step Account Form (127) | wherever its card is compact, 329–360 px: Apps at 1366–1440 px wide; Apps and Forms at 1024 and 641 px | the Forms lead card (695–1064 px); every card at 1280–1330, 1600 and 1920 px |
| Sign-up validation (117) | Forms at 1366–1440, 1024 and 641 px | 1280–1330, 1600 and 1920 px |

Sign-up validation also opens with a question, "How does a form tell the user what is wrong?", which the claim does not need.

## The Architectural Reality

- The captions are the records' `feature` strings in `apps/portal/resources/data/examples.json`. `apps/portal/resources/data/seo.json` repeats them as `description`, regenerated by `buildScripts/docs/rebuildContentIndexesAndSeo.mjs`.
- The two-line clamp is #21585's compact rule in `resources/css/src/apps/portal/examples/List.css`.
- Design authority: #21119's Contract Ledger, "a proof line of more than two lines is cut with an ellipsis and stays whole in the DOM", with the #21140 gate grading whether a stranger can read the claim.

## The Fix

1. Multi-Step Account Form: "Each step validates before Next and says what is wrong; the last step shows the submitted object" (96 characters).
2. Sign-up validation: "A sign-up form validates as you type, blocks submit and lists the errors" (72 characters).
3. Regenerate `seo.json`.

I measured both texts in place, on the same cards: two lines at every width above, down to the 329 px card.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] With #21585's clamp, both captions read whole at rest on every card view at 1440 × 900, 1366 × 768, 1024 × 768 and 641 × 800 (the narrowest compact card, 329 px).
- [ ] `seo.json` carries the new descriptions.
- [ ] The pull request carries the Apps and Forms & Fields cards before and after at 1440 × 900, dark, for the #21329 design-seat read.

## Out of Scope

- The other four long captions (Country Statistics Grid, Sparklines, Mermaid Diagrams, `plugin.Popover`): their groups' lanes.
- The field-type tiles (finding 8): the design-seat read of tile size.
- The phone: a resting card shows one caption line by design (#21584).

## Avoided Traps

- A 105-character rewrite ("…; Create account shows the object the form submits") is still cut at 1366, 1400, 1024 and 641 px.
- "Each step checks its fields before Next; Create account checks all and shows the object it submits" (98) fits too and keeps the check across steps, but drops what the form says about a wrong field. It stays the alternative for the design-seat read.
